info.title: BDSPro HTTP API
info.description: Contract for CURRENT Gin routes. No protobuf/gRPC endpoints are implied. Runtime behaviors, browser CSRF proof and live PostgreSQL authorization remain authoritative. Swagger UI enabled only in development.

Read projection of current live memberships, not an authorization grant.
